status_as_of_cutoff: local process: Stokes County officially voided the January 12, 2026 zoning changes and Project Delta rezoning, stating they have no legal effect and that any future application must start over. A new conditional rezoning application for approximately 1,848.741 acres was submitted by DFC Stokes, LLC and DFC Stokes 2, LLC, with Engineered Land Solutions, LLC as petitioner, and was scheduled for Stokes County Planning Board review on August 13, 2026. County staff recommended approval as reasonable and in the public interest, but no Planning Board recommendation, Board of Commissioners approval, building permit, construction start, interconnection approval, or energized status was verified as of 2026-08-11.
evidence_grade: B: official county notice/application/staff-report records verify active conditional-rezoning process, site, owners, petitioner, acreage, parcels, and staff recommendation; capacity, end user, final approval, permits, construction, and utility interconnection remain unverified.
